name: Esyllt

attributes.attribute: original of the Arthurian figure Iseult

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Esyllt was a Welsh heroine and the original of Iseult. Iseult became the romantic figure of the Arthurian legend. Esyllt was the wife of king March, who turned Mark. She was also the lover of his nephew Trystan, who became Trident. Her name may mean the one who is the one who gazes upon. Her name may be Germanic than Celtic. Her eloping with a young man, leaving her aging husband, mirrors the sovereignty goddess. Such a tale matches other Celtic myths of that land.

okr.objective: Rewrite the Esylt entry to the Arthurian romance.
